app.name: Canto
app.offlineHint: Audio analysis, instruments and display all run in this browser. Nothing is recorded or uploaded.
app.installedOffline: Ready offline. You can practise without a network connection.
app.updateAvailable: A new version is ready. Reload to update.

mic.consent: Canto needs your microphone to show your pitch. The signal is analysed on this device and never leaves it.
mic.statusSilence: No sound detected. Sing a steady note.
mic.statusWeak: Too quiet. Move closer to the microphone.
mic.statusUnstable: Pitch unclear. Hold one steady vowel.
mic.errorDenied: Microphone access was refused. Allow it in your browser site settings, then enable it again.
mic.errorUnavailable: No microphone was found. Connect an input device and try again.
mic.errorInterrupted: The microphone input stopped. Check the device, then enable it again.
mic.errorUnsupported: This browser cannot capture audio here. Use HTTPS, or localhost in development.
mic.headphonesHint: Using speakers? The instrument can leak into the microphone. Headphones give a cleaner reading.
mic.statusGated: Your input stopped sending audio mid-note. This is filtering outside the browser: try another microphone below, or turn off audio enhancements for this device in your system settings.

piano.label: Piano keyboard
piano.keyboardHint: Computer keyboard: A W S E D F T G Y H U J K play the lower octave, Z X C V B N M the next one up. Arrow left and right change octave.

trace.label: Voice pitch over the last eight seconds
trace.readingDirection: Now is at the keyboard; older pitch rises.

footer.privacy: No account, no server, no audio leaves this device.

diag.title: Capture diagnostics
diag.hint: Live values from the local audio pipeline. Nothing here is recorded or sent.
diag.processingOn: Still on: the browser kept echo cancellation, noise suppression or gain control
diag.reapplied: Constraints re-applied after the browser ignored them
